name: geocn-monorepo
description: GeoCN - Open-source geographic UI registry and cartographic component ecosystem
author: GeoCN Contributors

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run registry:build && npm run build --workspace=@geocn/www
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@geocn/geo && npm run build --workspace=@geocn/ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:root && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
